- Section Seven: Laws and Rules of the Road","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C - Section Seven: Laws and Rules of the Road

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Yield at controls to priority holders; solid red means stop with right turns allowed unless banned after stopping and yielding, red arrows ban turns till green, flashing red means stop-then-go [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
Solid yellow warns of red ahead: stop when safe, else cross carefully; yellow arrows end protected turns, and committed drivers finish, watching the next signal [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A02
Flashing yellow means slow without stopping, flashing arrows allow yielded turns, green means go while yielding inside with exit room, green arrows protect, dead signals mean all-way stops [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A03
WALK means cross, DON'T WALK means wait, flashing DON'T WALK means hold back, drivers still yielding; countdowns time crossings, diagonal walks allow any direction, sounds guide the blind [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A03
STOP signs demand full stops at the crosswalk, line, or entry, checking all ways; red YIELD signs demand slowing, ready to stop for all traffic [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A04
Red-and-white signs ban moves like U-turns and turns, white signs post no parking, one way, do not block, plus construction, guide, hazmat, slow-vehicle art [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A05
Yellow warnings preview wet slipperiness, merging traffic, divided-highway shifts, two-way traffic, ending lanes, signals ahead, crossings, added lanes, crossroads, stop or yield ahead, curves, windings [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A06
Obey red-and-white orders like DO NOT ENTER, retreat from WRONG WAY signs, red night reflectors confirming; yellow-black circles and Xes mark rail crossings, pentagons schools, diamonds dangers, rectangles rules [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A07
First arrival owns the right-of-way while the rest wait; never assume it; surrender it to stop crashes, scan unsigned crossings fully, always honoring pedestrians [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A07
Unsigned ties defer right, all-way stops matching after stopping, T junctions favor the through road, lefts yield to pedestrians and close traffic, rights scan crossers, and blocking crossings with no exit room is illegal [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A08
Roundabouts circle one way: slow, yield inside, enter right into gaps, go counterclockwise, no stops or passes, signal exits, loop on a miss; multi-lane rights keep right, straights exit as entered [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A09
Walkers, skaters, boarders, and disabled riders count as pedestrians yet obey road rules; drivers slow for crossers, never pass stopped cars at crossings, read eye contact as a cue; all crosswalks grant priority with stops at the limit line [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A10
Blind pedestrians with dogs or canes always hold priority and wave drivers on, cane stowed; steep passes favor uphill vehicles, downhill ones reversing [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A10
Trucks hide cars in No Zones, so hidden mirrors mean you are hidden; braking grows with weight and speed, cars at fifty-five stopping inside three hundred feet, loaded trucks four hundred [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A11
Long vehicles swing wide, so read their signals before passing; on wide divided roads they keep the two rightmost lanes, drivers never cut in, never linger, safety zones stay undriven, stopped transit passes at ten [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A12
Never pass rail vehicles or streetcars left except past right-hugging tracks, on one-ways, by officer order; light rail shares road rights, hides behind obstacles, preempts signals, never to be cut off [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A12
Motorcycles share full road rights; drivers check mirrors and blind spots, hold three seconds, grant the whole lane, never pass in-lane, check before opening doors, shift aside [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec07-F18 | anchor: A13
Emergency vehicles with sirens and lights own the right-of-way: pull right and stop, move over for flashers, clear intersections, obey officers over signs, never trail within three hundred feet; slow triangular rigs get room [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-F19 | anchor: A14
Scooters, neighborhood electrics, golf carts share roads slowly, NEVs capped at twenty-five and barred past thirty-five; horse-drawn traffic shares lanes, scaring banned; cyclists hold full rights: freeway stretches lacking alternates, hazard dodges, crosswalk use [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-F20 | anchor: A15
Cyclists obey signs, ride with traffic, shoulder-check, yield to pedestrians, helmet up under eighteen, stay visible and right, signal, brake well; night bikes carry a white lamp for three hundred feet, red rear light for five hundred, pedal and wheel reflectors [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-F21 | anchor: A15
Slow riders hug the right curb except when passing, turning, dodging hazards, or narrowed out of sharing [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-F22 | anchor: A16
Pass cyclists by changing lanes, or hold three feet when lane-locked, waiting otherwise; never squeeze riders, tuck behind before turning, enter bike lanes within two hundred feet, minding blind spots [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-F23 | anchor: A17
Work zones demand slowing, wider gaps, and full attention past cones and flaggers with early merges; violations cost one thousand-plus, fines double in enhanced or staffed zones, worker assault risks two thousand and a year inside, and drivers move over for amber-lit rigs [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-F24 | anchor: A18
Diamond placards flag dangerous loads stopping before rail tracks; bad traffic and weather demand slowing without blocking flow, tow rigs and three-axle trucks live far right, yield right to faster followers [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec07-F25 | anchor: A18
School zones cap at twenty-five within five hundred feet of children, some at fifteen; scan for young cyclists, walkers, patrols, buses, reading yellow flashers as prepare-to-stop [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec07-F26 | anchor: A19
Red bus flashers stop both directions till children cross and flashing ends, violators risking one thousand dollars and a year unlicensed, while buses across divided or multi-lane roads release the far side [A19].
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec07-F27 | anchor: A19
Blind intersections, alleys cap at fifteen, rail crossings cap at fifteen where tracks hide past four hundred feet unless controlled, flashing reds forbid crossing till they end, warnings demand fifteen-foot stops, gates stay unducked, crossings need stop, look, listen [A19].
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec07-F28 | anchor: A20
Expect trains on any track anytime either way, never stop on rails, never enter without full exit room, and watch mandatory stoppers: buses, placarded trucks; business and residential zones cap at twenty-five unless posted [A20].
Source: [A20 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec07-F29 | anchor: A20
No smoking with minors aboard, no animal dumping under fine and jail threat, no overloads, no cargo past the left fender, six inches right, no rear overhangs past four feet without a twelve-inch flag or two red night lights, no loose riders or video, no flaming litter [A20].
Source: [A20 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec07-F30 | anchor: A21
Windshields stay clear save a seven-inch passenger square, five-inch driver square, five-inch toll square, rear side windows; marked funeral processions own priority, interruption ticketed, plates legible and unaltered [A21].
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec07-F31 | anchor: A21
Fleeing police by car means misdemeanor jail up to a year, pursuit injuries draw up to seven years, pursuit manslaughter four to ten, unlicensed use impounds your car thirty days, injurious reckless or contest driving draws jail, fines [A21].
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec07-F32 | anchor: A22
Skipped court dates suspend driving, marking the record, convictions persist thirty-six-plus months, adults trip negligent status at four in twelve, six in twenty-four, or eight in thirty-six months, one-point tickets trade once per eighteen months for insurer-hiding school [A22].
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F33 | anchor: A22
Point overload brings probation, suspension, revocation, hearings, written notice, hit-and-run and injurious reckless driving force revocation, courts can suspend, and relicensing demands financial proof [A22].
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F34 | anchor: A23
Year-one provisional crashes, tickets bring restriction; minors draw action at one at-fault event, a thirty-day ban at two unless a licensed twenty-five-plus adult rides along, six-month suspension, year probation at three, year bans for substance convictions to age twenty; hearings lapse ten days post-service, fourteen post-mailing [A23].
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F35 | anchor: A24
Hearings grant evidence, witnesses, testimony or counsel, cross-examination, with subpoenas on you against a documents-only case; unsafe drivers face reexamination, records public save conditions, addresses, social numbers [A24].
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0062]
